parameters.query: SELECT id, trigger_inactive_days FROM nurture_sequences WHERE is_active = true;

INSERT INTO nurture_enrollments (sequence_id, contact_id, current_step, status, enrolled_at)
SELECT $1, c.id, 0, 'active', now()
FROM contacts c
WHERE c.is_archived = false
  AND c.email IS NOT NULL AND c.email <> ''
  AND GREATEST(c.updated_at, COALESCE((SELECT MAX(created_at) FROM entity_activity_log WHERE entity_type = 'contact' AND entity_id = c.id), c.created_at)) <= now() - ($2 || ' days')::interval
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nurture_enrollments ne WHERE ne.sequence_id = $1 AND ne.contact_id = c.id)
ON CONFLICT (sequence_id, contact_id) DO NOTHING;

nodes.name: Auto-Enroll Eligible Contacts
nodes.notes: One-time enrollment per sequence per contact (UNIQUE constraint + ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING). Newly-enrolled contacts get picked up for step-sending on next hour's run, not this one — simpler than same-run ordering, and a 1-hour delay is invisible at this cadence.

parameters.query:
SELECT ne.id AS enrollment_id, ne.sequence_id, ne.contact_id, ne.current_step, ne.enrolled_at, ne.last_step_sent_at,
  ns.exit_on_reply, ns.exit_lead_status, ns.on_reply_workflow_id, ns.on_complete_tag_name,
  c.email, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.email_logs,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM nurture_sequence_steps WHERE sequence_id = ns.id) AS total_steps
FROM nurture_enrollments ne
JOIN nurture_sequences ns ON ns.id = ne.sequence_id AND ns.is_active = true
JOIN contacts c ON c.id = ne.contact_id AND c.is_archived = false
WHERE ne.status = 'active';

nodes.name: Select Active Enrollments
nodes.notes: Independent of the auto-enroll branch above — both fire straight off the schedule trigger, no ordering dependency between them.

parameters.query:
WITH exit_update AS (
  UPDATE nurture_enrollments SET status = 'exited_reply', exited_at = now(), exit_reason = 'Contact replied'
  WHERE id = $1
  RETURNING contact_id
),
status_update AS (
  UPDATE contacts SET lead_status = $2, updated_at = now()
  WHERE id = (SELECT contact_id FROM exit_update) AND $2::text IS NOT NULL
  RETURNING id
)
INSERT INTO entity_activity_log (entity_type, entity_id, category, subtype, summary, detail, actor_id, actor_name)
SELECT 'contact', contact_id, 'system_audit', 'created',
  'Nurture sequence stopped — contact replied' || CASE WHEN $2::text IS NOT NULL THEN '; status set to ' || $2 ELSE '' END,
  NULL::jsonb, NULL, 'Automation'
FROM exit_update
RETURNING id;
UPDATE nurture_enrollments SET status = 'completed', exited_at = now(), exit_reason = 'Sequence finished' WHERE id = $1;

parameters.query: INSERT INTO taggables (tag_id, entity_type, entity_id) VALUES ($1, 'contact', $2) ON CONFLICT (tag_id, entity_type, entity_id) DO NOTHING;

SELECT nss.delay_days, et.subject AS email_subject, et.body AS email_body
FROM nurture_sequence_steps nss
JOIN email_templates et ON et.id = nss.email_template_id
WHERE nss.sequence_id = $1 AND nss.step_number = $2;

WITH updated AS (
  UPDATE nurture_enrollments SET current_step = $1, last_step_sent_at = now() WHERE id = $2 RETURNING contact_id
)
INSERT INTO entity_activity_log (entity_type, entity_id, category, subtype, summary, detail, actor_id, actor_name)
SELECT 'contact', contact_id, 'system_audit', 'created', 'Nurture email sent: "' || $3 || '"', NULL::jsonb, NULL, 'Automation'
FROM updated
RETURNING id;
